_schema: Ricarti Drywall portfolio. One entry per project; order = display order. Never put house numbers in any field. Leave unknown facts null (they are not shown). documented_work lists only work visible in the project photos; keys: custom-homes, renovation, commercial, architectural, insulation, drywall-finishing. Photos: put web images (900x1600 JPG) in /images; cover = 4:5 crop at 1000px and 600px. Captions and alt text need en and pt.
